$schema_note: keyword-matchcut-intro manifest v1. Paths relative to this file. Replace every value with REAL captured data; never invent pages.

schema.keyword: string, required. Exact text as given by the user (no simplified/traditional conversion).

sources[].url: string, required. Real page URL the screenshot came from (or search-results URL)
sources[].title: string, page title as shown
sources[].keyword_bbox: [x, y, w, h] required, in IMAGE pixels (multiply CSS px by devicePixelRatio). Tight box around the keyword occurrence.

schema.rules: min 3 entries (distinct passages); >=2 distinct urls recommended; render.py errors if keyword_bbox missing
